descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
What you’ll do 
Design, develop, and maintain embedded software for automotive applications
Implement and optimize low-level drivers and middleware components in C
Develop software solutions based on AUTOSAR Classic Platform architecture
Configure and integrate AUTOSAR Basic Software (BSW) modules and MCAL components
Participate in software architecture definition and design reviews
Perform debugging, root cause analysis, and performance optimization on embedded targets
Support board bring-up activities and hardware/software integration
Collaborate with system architects, hardware engineers, validation teams, and customers
Create and maintain software requirements, design specifications, implementation documentation, and test reports
Contribute to software quality activities following ASPICE and ISO 26262 processes
 What you need to be successful 
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electronics, Telecommunications, or a related field
Strong experience in embedded software development using C, with solid knowledge of ARM architectures (Cortex-M/A/R) and microcontrollers/peripherals
Good understanding of RTOS concepts, memory management, interrupt handling, device drivers, and bootloaders
Experience with embedded debugging tools (JTAG, GDB, Lauterbach/Trace32)
Knowledge of AUTOSAR Classic Platform and automotive communication protocols (CAN, LIN, Ethernet, FlexRay)
Experience with Git and build systems (Make/CMake)
Experience in software integration, testing, and debugging
Good communication skills in English
 Nice to have 
Experience with AUTOSAR Classic, including MCAL development and BSW configuration using EB tresos and Vector DaVinci
Knowledge of automotive communication technologies, including Automotive Ethernet
Familiarity with Functional Safety (ISO 26262) and ASPICE processes
Experience with Embedded Linux
Understanding of embedded systems security concepts
